beats.text: The Guided Record — LIRIL reads the public record of Canada aloud, act by act: every claim cited, every source one click away.
Next: If you are not ready for the full film.

This is not entertainment. Canada has lost more than 100,000 people to failures the public record already documents — policy, neglect, capture, and refusal to enforce. Scale that harm to the United States and the figure would exceed a million. We name sources so the living can still verify, and so the dead are not reduced to spectacle.

LIRIL walks the record in order: government publications, court files, Hansard, open data. Pause when you need to. Resume tomorrow. Jump by act. Every claim that can be checked is meant to be checked.
